description: Fish Audio cloud TTS (Speech 2.1) — voice cloning via reference IDs
api_key_hint: Paste the raw key — it is wrapped into 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' automatically. Get one at https://fish.audio (API keys page).

extra_fields.label: Model
extra_fields.hint: Sent as the 'model' HTTP header. s2.1-pro-free routes requests to the free tier so you aren't billed.

extra_fields.label: Audio format
extra_fields.hint: Sent as the payload 'format' field. Fish Audio's pcm output is 44100 Hz.

extra_fields.label: Reference voice ID
extra_fields.hint: ID of the cloned/library voice this persona speaks with. Sent as 'reference_id' in the {text, reference_id, format} payload.
